verdict.rationale: Cal.com's app store explicitly offers a Zapier app that triggers automations when a booking is created, rescheduled or cancelled. It also documents an Attio CRM sync and registrable webhooks for BOOKING_CREATED and related events. Salesforce and HubSpot appear as app-store integrations and in CRM routing lookups, but the evidence never states that bookings are pushed into them. missing for 10: documented booking-to-record sync behavior for Salesforce and HubSpot (field mapping, contact/event creation), independent hands-on corroboration of CRM sync.

support.subject: As a sales lead, bookings flow into my CRM and automation stack (Salesforce, HubSpot, Zapier) without manual copying

citations.quote: Use the Cal.com Zapier app to automate your workflows when a booking is created, rescheduled, cancelled or when a meeting ends.
Sync your Cal.com bookings and meetings directly into Attio. Use the Cal.com Attio integration to automatically keep your CRM up to date with your scheduling activity.
